items.title: Square Enix scrambles to fix Final Fantasy 14 bug where new beastmaster could crash entire servers
items.summary: Beast mode activated.

content.v: Final Fantasy 14's latest job has just hit the proverbial shelves, and you know what that means: emergency maintenance to fix an extremely bizarre bug. On Sep. 8, the same day that the new beastmaster class dropped, Square Enix had to quickly patch out a bug where "if the player's character leaves the area due to a connection loss at the moment the pet uses a weapon skill that restores its master's HP, the server may crash."

Yes, this bug wasn't crashing the player's own game, but the server. While it's a pretty fringe set of circumstances that have to line up, it's easily replicated with a cheeky pull of one's ethernet cable, so it makes sense that Square Enix scrambled to address this before it became a catastrophe.

If you're unfamiliar with the beastmaster, it's one of the game's "limited jobs" along with the blue mage—basically, they are classes that can't be used to clear the main story quest or endgame dungeons, but they get a bunch of unconventional abilities to futz around with. They are broadly accessible side novelties, and with everyone piling in to check out the new one, it could have been a disaster had this bug been allowed to fester.

It's not the first time Square Enix has had to tackle a bizarre bug in the MMO. Just last year it won the coveted " Most Specific Bug Fix in a MMO " award from PC Gamer's Harvey Randall. With that one, players could get disconnected from the server if they listed an auction house item in a specific zone with an asking price set "between 44,442 gil and 49,087 gil."

It's the sort of bug that sounds like it was made up as an illustrative example of how bizarre bugs can be. But whether it's the funniest in recent memory is still up for debate, given the ' random buffs ' incident from back in 2023.

items.title: GTA: London 1961 is full of cockney innuendo and harder than a bobby’s helmet
items.summary: In your end-o.

content.v: Weird Weekend is our regular Saturday column where we celebrate PC gaming oddities: peculiar games, strange bits of trivia, forgotten history. Pop back every weekend to find out what Jeremy, Josh, Ted, and Rick have become obsessed with this time, whether it's the canon height of Thief's Garrett or that time someone in the Vatican pirated Football Manager .

In the wake of GTA 6, series veterans will wax nostalgically about the era of Rockstar expansion packs. No sooner had you finished The Lost and Damned, they'll tell their nurse in between spoonfuls of prunes, The Ballad of Gay Tony landed on your hard drive. There was none of this 'waiting a decade for a new GTA' nonsense.

Fewer will remember the first age of Grand Theft Auto, when even the expansion packs had expansion packs. Really—GTA birthed GTA: London, which in turn begat GTA: London 1961. The latter was released for free online in the summer of 1999, where only a subset of disc-spinning PC gamers were ever likely to find it. Which might have been for the best. Because GTA: London 1961 is perhaps the most punishing visit to the British capital ever conceived. Even including 28 Days Later, and the press reception of Meghan and Harry.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/h2qMwZfBYSBUaHjcsq5TuX.jpg

The original Grand Theft Auto already demanded a lot from its players—splicing a nascent open world structure with the limited lives and scorechasing of the arcades. To pass a given level, you'd need to complete several back-to-back chains of missions, thereby building a sufficient multiplier to reach the target score. Getting busted would halve your multiplier instantly. And since cops only needed to bump into you to effect an arrest, like a ghost in Pac-Man, you could easily wind up back at square one, with a dwindling pool of missions to pick from.
GTA: London 1961 is perhaps the most punishing visit to the British capital ever conceived.

To this brutal ruleset, the designers of GTA: London 1961 decided to add mission timers tighter than Adam West's batsuit. How does 20 seconds from East Bermondsey to West Southwark strike you? Or 30 from Westminster Palace to the City of London, where the bankers work? Even in GTA's shrunken top-down metropolis, it's an extraordinary ask—only possible if you pick precisely the right route, floor it, and somehow avoid any serious collisions along the way. "You got to be a little faster," explains your cock-er-ney paymaster, helpfully. "Or Harold'll have your guts for gardening with!"

And should you fail, even once? Those same gangsters will throw you out on your arse, ending the mission with no way of recovery. "This ain't some leisurely afternoon stroll with a stunning bird! This is major international crime, and time and crime waits for Norman, as Harold once said! You blew it, you nob!"
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ymKF2s98uyv5FFaL6s98uX.jpg
I can't help but wonder how Harold can afford to be so picky with his drivers. If he's got Charlie Croker on the other end of the blower, why is he talking to me in the first place? Good riddance.

Except, without the largesse of old Harold, making money in London is no walk in the park. It might be a drive through Hyde Park, knocking down pedestrians in precise combos to try and max out your score the hard way. Or a slow, repetitive shift at the docks, feeding endless stolen cars to the crane in exchange for £100 notes. I scuppered my chances there by rolling an enormous red bus halfway into the Thames, blocking the crane and making future deliveries impossible.

Thankfully, I'm not the first person to be astonished by the obscenity of those mission timers. And GTA: London 1961 belongs to a time when in-game values could be easily tweaked via notepad files buried on your PC. A kind fellow traveller named Duckilous left instructions on the GTA Forums —an added 30 seconds here, an extra 2375 frames there—and it's no exaggeration to say that those simple inputs are transformative. "I am not a modder for the classic GTA games," my saviour writes. "This is something I just figured out in one day."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/49ZjmymmLgsZHF8artnrtX.jpg

Duckilous' GTA London: 1961 remains a frantic, frazzling dash through pixellated renderings of some of the world's most famous landmarks. But that extra inch of breathing room makes all the difference. Another half a minute per mission means you actually have time to read what your objectives are before haring off towards them.
That extra inch of breathing room makes all the difference.

You even get a moment to appreciate the, ah, prose: "What the hell are you doing? You left Mr Caukenbolls all alone. Now some gang has kidnapped him. You'd better find him and get him back here, unharmed! A miss is as good as a moron in this game, mate."

Crucially, the added time means you get to complete more objectives, and therefore access more missions further down the chain. Among GTA: London 1961's scenarios are the theft of a rival gangster's clothes during a pond swim, the filming of a bespoke documentary for Harold to watch at home, and the first-ever implementation of driveby mechanics in the series. There's even a bit of Bond-lite cruising in a Jaguar with a union jack paint job, called the Jug Swinger.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xFMSSj59xQrKxsy4LouqjX.jpg

But it's all over pretty fast. This, I now realise, is what the vicious timers were likely covering for: a damning scarcity of scripted missions. I managed to complete four of seven and, having failed the others, was left scraping around to make up the shortfall in my level score.

When run over with a 3x multiplier, policemen yield 3000 points each, and I calculated I'd need to pancake only about a dozen to reach the target. But eventually, even the coppers stopped showing up. London's streets turned eerily quiet, as if every last response unit in Scotland Yard had at last been totalled or exploded. The war was over.

In the end, I was combing the city from Camden to Camberwell, searching for one last way to eke out enough damage to sufficiently impress London's criminal class. And eventually, I found it: a tank parked on a football field. The cars and buildings of Westminster rocked with concussive force as rockets flew. Buckingham Palace's window bill for 1962 would be enormous. But I could finally say I'd completed GTA's toughest challenge to date. Give or take a 30 second timer.

items.title: Final Fantasy 14's funky new roguelike mode has me hyped for Evercold's combat revamp, which'll be a winner if it's even half as weird
items.summary: Who let the dogs out?

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PgGhmt5pTtxusaQQX3dHPF.png

This is Terminally Online : PC Gamer's very own MMO column. Every other week, I'll be sharing my thoughts on the genre, interviewing fellow MMO-heads like me, taking a deep-dive into mechanics we've all taken for granted, and, occasionally, bringing in guest writers to talk about their MMO of choice.

I've had a little time to muck around with Final Fantasy 14 's new Beastmaster limited job—for the uninitiated, a limited job is sort of like a minigame. Not an actual class you can take into current raids or dungeons, but a side-activity that uses the game's combat system to create something new.

The Beastmaster can tame and use creatures in combat. And for the first 30 levels, I was mostly just filling out my little book of monsters in a pleasant haze. I like the job's core combat mechanics, which involve pairing up axe strikes with specific monster abilities to form combos, but grinding in the overworld doesn't do much to show that off.
Where the Beastmaster really shines is in the Crucible of the Unbroken, the limited job's roguelike mode.

I was mostly expecting a straightforward list of bosses to push over via FF14 fun, but played-out combat mechanics, and there is some of that demand. But it's mixed with an overarching minigame of strategy and ability usage that has me watering at the mouth for whatever strange, eldritch things Evercold is cooking up.

For context, Evercold will be introducing "Evolved" jobs —a means to escape the game's rote, two-minute cooldown homogenization that's plagued it for years. During the look we've gotten at these, it seems Square Enix wants to reintroduce job identity to each of the existing jobs by giving them something weird.

For example, the Paladin gets defensive abilities they can essentially "parry" with, unlocking huge punishes if they time them moments before a powerful blow lands. The Dragoon will get an ultimate jump ability and, while it is still being deliberated, the developers have teased the idea of giving the Dragoon a 90% damage resistance buff while they're up in the air. The Dragoon is a DPS job. This'd be unprecedented.

But it's hard to tell, with any development studio, where the hype ends and the overpromising begins. Will Square Enix be brave enough to commit? The Crucible of the Unbroken tells me they very much might.

Granted, this is an isolated bit of content off the beaten path, but it's clear that Square's been using it to experiment with job design that's more reactive to the encounter at hand, rather than just hitting the same buttons every two minutes.

You get given 10 of your collected pets to bring with you into your run—while you can bring three into a battle at a time. Each of these critters have a "Trick" ability, which hits a certain elemental damage type (and enables your Axe combos), a "Tempered Release" ability, which is unique to that creature, and a "Borrow" ability, which is unique to that creature's type.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zehufFSUpSQYuPR38eFcYd.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kdST9paSNxmQNA5oM6PhWd.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/892b5QCtDJTXQGhPccSNad.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2tiT4m8WQPj7KqKvnvHsbd.png

Doing well in crucible battles isn't about memorising your rotation by rote—or even by memorising mechanics, really, although the Crucible is punishing if you mess anything up, as any good roguelike should be. It's about bringing specific beasties to specific encounters and using them in specific phases.

For example, one boss I fought had a mid-fight phase in which four flames steadily advanced to the centre, slapping me with a debuff if I didn't kill them in time. They're weak to water, so I brought out my favourite crab bro, borrowed his "you can spam water attacks now" ability, and melted them down.

This extends to a lot of other mechanics, too. If you want to interrupt a cast, you need a specific critter for that. If you want to endure a massive tankbuster, you'll need to borrow a defensive ability from one of your animal friends.

You aren't just deciding which scissor, paper, or rock to use—the crucible forces you to be deliberate in a few ways. Firstly, these bosses constantly output damage. You can choose to have the boss either attack you or your pet, but health loss is permanent and can only be restored by items or campfires.

You don't want to die, because then you fail the run, but you also might want your pet to live for a future battle—or conversely, you might have a (literal) sacrificial lamb. Furthermore, swapping between pets has a long cooldown, so you're going to have a beastie out for a while. It's a little like the game's already-existing Bard job, wherein you have three songs that last for 45 minutes a pop.

It's extremely compelling, and I've legitimately felt like I'm putting together custom strategies for each fight—all the while juggling my own rotation and dancing between AoE danger zones. And it gives me hope that Evercold's new evolved jobs will be super weird, too.

Maybe not just as weird. Obviously, Beastmaster's occupancy as a limited job gives it a lot more room to experiment—but the Crucible does feel like a testing ground for concepts in future raids and fights. I can easily see a world in which a specific set of jobs are able to simply skip entire mechanics because of their unique abilities.

I don't want a puzzle for every old casual dungeon boss, mind—but I do want those same eureka moments where you realise you've got the perfect answer to a mechanic on your action bar, rather than just memorised as 'this particle effect means we stack up, this one means we spread'. If "evolved" combat design is half as experimental as Beastmaster, then Final Fantasy 14 will have finally shaked off the dust .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UjCJY9gjRfatHZjCuGMrhR.jpg

items.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker is a good game, but one change would make it a great RPG
items.summary: The prologue promises something the game never quite delivers.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ckZUwfxbakq5yXMJMfSmBW.png

Welcome to Dungeon Master , PC Gamer's regular RPG column, where Online Editor Fraser Brown delves into PC gaming's most beloved and enduring genre. Grab a seat in our badly-lit tavern and please ignore the goblin puke.

The Blood of Dawnwalker is good stuff—over the course of a week I drank deeply and had a grand ol' time walking on walls and carving people up with my monstrous claws. But as a choice-laden RPG that promised a lot of agency, it ended up being a bit of a disappointment. There were plenty of choices to be made, but rarely did they leave an impact on either the world or the white bread protagonist, Coen of Laslea.
Rebel Wolves made Coen in the mold of Geralt of Rivia, in that he's a defined character who you can nudge in different directions, but Coen is no Geralt.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FFY9R7fKJAew58Lp52P7y6.jpg

By The Witcher 3 , CDPR had the two previous games to lean on, along with a boat-load of books, which helped the studio create a well-defined, consistent character no matter what choices you made. Coen, on the other hand, is just at the start of his journey , and in Dawnwalker, his defining feature is that he loves his family.

Look, I don't mind Coen. Will de Renzy-Martin gave a good performance, but it's hard to do much with a character who's just a nice boy. And while the writers did some interesting stuff in regards to Coen's childhood trauma and his obligation to his family—is it love, or is he trapped in a prison of responsibility?—he's mostly just a pleasant dude.

The choices players face fall into the traditional binary category, which in this case means you can either choose a Coen who is willing to do everything to save his family except become a monster, or a Coen who is willing to do everything to save his family including becoming a monster—but is still mostly a good egg.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/d6uwN8SCa4dfkQmDM2NAe8.jpg

Unfortunately, this changes surprisingly little. If you let a vrakhir collaborator go free or murder them, it might change how you feel about the character you're playing, but the world itself couldn't care less. Until the epilogue, most choices you make happen in the background, in a vacuum, and the choices you'd expect to have the greatest impact, like how you choose to defeat Brencis, are largely detached from the kind of Coen you've been playing for 40 hours.

I played Coen as wholesome and naive, but I still found myself able to get every ending. It just came down to which route to Brencis I decided to settle on at the last moment. How I comported myself had no impact. And even though I tried to be consistent when it came to how I roleplayed Coen, the voice direction would often take things in a very different direction, transforming, for instance, what appeared to be a neutral statement into an angry criticism.

This is something that often bugs me in voice-acted RPGs. The acting and direction can dramatically change the tone of a line in a way that feels incongruous to the rest of the conversation, and this happens so much in Dawnwalker. It's something CDPR deftly resolved in The Witcher by making Geralt incredibly stoic. Doug Cockle has plenty of range, but when he's playing Geralt it's extremely subtle, which maintains the consistency of each dialogue sequence.
Final countdown
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xxrGtHGdM5PQL2WEVNeRoJ.jpg

But Dawnwalker has something most RPGs don't: a ticking clock. And while the most obvious benefit is the sense of urgency it blesses the game with, it also seemed like a promising roleplaying mechanic—helping players to better define their version of Coen by determining what's most important to him.

This is felt most keenly in the prologue, before Coen becomes a dawnwalker. You have one day to do some chores before everyone in the village has to visit the church to get drained by their undead rulers. It's impossible to do everything . Do you focus on helping your fellow villagers? Or do you spend the day hanging out with your family? What's most important to your Coen?

Even during this single day, there's a tangible sense of time moving inexorably forwards. For instance, early in the day you'll meet your siblings, who want to spend time with you and go down to the river. If you decline initially, later you'll find that they've gone to the river by themselves, and you can meet them down there, or just continue to ignore them. There's a schedule.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MkE3iUWNMfrRXLJkVu9bVG.png

This promise of time's fickle nature is largely done away with after you complete the prologue. You have 30 days to finish the game—if you want to save your family, anyway—but within those 30 days any time pressure is just an illusion. You'll meet people on the second day who want your help, and they'll still be waiting around for you by the 25th day.

In my entire playthrough, outside of the prologue, I only encountered a single quest where I ran out of time. I could have caught up with an old friend who joined the rebels, but once I'd completed all the quests for the organisation, they mobilised to take on Brencis, at which point I could no longer hang out with my pal. According to our guide lead Sean Martin, who completed every quest Dawnwalker offered, he only found one other example of this happening.

So I never had to make any tough choices. Do I hang out with the mean vampire lady and learn more about the monster I'm becoming? Or do I have a magical adventure with the friendly witch who wants to help me save my family? It doesn't matter because I can always do both.
Evening plans
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4Zj3DgW9d5cR4oHgvgwes6.jpg

There's definitely an argument for making Dawnwalker's time limit 20 days instead of 30, but I think that might make the adventure feel too rushed. Instead, sticking with 30 days but putting individual quests on a timer would make a lot more sense. This forces you to make decisions about how Coen should spend his time every day, as well as giving NPCs more agency, while still letting you do a lot.

Being made to choose between staging a jailbreak or assassinating a high-ranking soldier is a much more effective way to establish who Coen is compared to the extremely common choice of: drink a barrel of blood or smash a barrel of blood. It also leaves room for meaningful consequences—like discovering the terrible fate of the prisoners if you opted to do the assassination mission instead, and having other characters actually reference it.
What's frustrating is that you occasionally see glimmers of this, like the time of day you do a quest subtly changing how things play out.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4fRTiVosLRDw2tSSKk8cqH.jpg

When I tried to meet up with the rebels for the first time, I played through it twice: once during the day, and once at night. At night, I found a rebel being harassed by soldiers, who were immediately hostile to me. After I quickly murdered the soldiers, the rebel took me to meet her friends, but I sensed a trap thanks to my supernatural skills, and avoided getting my leg stuck in a snare.

Attempting this in the afternoon, I was actually able to talk to the soldiers instead of killing them immediately. Rather than fighting, I bribed them to leave the rebel alone. But when I was brought to meet her fellow rebels, I walked right into the snare trap.

This was cool! Though it didn't actually matter at all. In vampire form, even though I avoided the first trap, the rebels ended up jumping me and chaining me to a tree. No matter the time of day, the end result was the same.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UyPkx27rQ7fixw27odnigB.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8H2F3G7p2ZVDt9oX4BcuHT.jpg

items.title: BlizzCon 2026 Opening Ceremony live coverage and how to watch—what's next for Warcraft, Overwatch, Diablo, and StarCraft
items.summary: Big announcements are expected at Blizzard's first fan convention since 2023.

content.v: BlizzCon 2026 kicks off today with the Opening Ceremony at 10:30 am PT , where we're expecting major announcements about what the next several years hold for the developer. The festivities can be viewed in the player above, or on YouTube here.

There are rumors that a new StarCraft game will be announced, and Blizzard has lightly teased the possibility. There's also been lots of chatter about possible a new spin on World of Warcraft: Classic, which players are referring to as "Classic Plus."
Beyond that, expect news about Overwatch, Hearthstone, and Diablo. It's been three years since the last BlizzCon in 2023, so the developer has had some time to cook.

I'm on scene at the convention in Anaheim, and will be reporting the big news from the Opening Ceremony in the live blog below, adding information I've gathered here wherever I have it. Look for deeper coverage on the big announcements throughout the coming week.
RTS or FPS?
A StarCraft FPS has been rumored for a bit now, but speculation has also gone on regarding the possibility of a new StarCraft RTS. If you can only have one, which are you picking?
If there were any doubt...
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/M2GNfR5FZ9KwxwKRZcugmU.jpg

items.title: 根本抢不到！苹果18Pro一机难求 涨价千元开抢秒空
items.summary: iPhone 18 Pro开售一分钟售罄，涨价千元仍一机难求，官网被挤崩。

content.v: 9月12日晚20点，iPhone 18 Pro系列正式开启预售，火爆程度远超预期。今年新机涨价千元，起步价来到9999元，仍未挡住抢购热潮；开售前全平台预约总量突破450万，热门配色与大内存版本开售瞬间被一抢而空，不到一分钟便全线售罄，发货周期排到半个月之后，其中Pro Max酒红色版本货源最少。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122212011990.jpg
社交平台上大量果粉晒出抢购实况：卡点下单直接页面崩溃，连苹果官网都被流量挤崩。随后，苹果18抢不到迅速冲上热搜。即便成功下单，部分用户发货也要等上大半个月。
供需紧张的核心原因，是苹果今年砍掉了iPhone 18标准版，全部购机需求集中到Pro系列，放大了供货缺口。据快科技查询，京东自营渠道iPhone 18 Pro Max预约量突破170万、iPhone 18 Pro突破240万，两款合计超410万。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122212417672.png
据蓝鲸新闻报道，发布会当晚各大黄牛社群便开启大批量收机，新机未开售就已有人锁单。黄牛行情火热主要源于国行与港版价差拉大：256GB国行9999元、港版约8985元，差价超千元；2TB Pro Max国行21499元、港版约18699元，差价达2800元，跨区套利空间显著，大批黄牛准备从香港拿货销往内地。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122213048392.jpg

items.title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World Has 500 Beasts to Collect, and They're All Super Weird | IGN Preview
items.summary: So far, Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World is shaping up to be another solid and charming entry in the

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/dqm-tww-broll-synthesis-combat-04-0-14-07-51-1789173232367.png
Key Preview Takeaways:

While the core Dragon Quest games are the main draw for many fans of this long-running franchise, the well-established Dragon Quest Monsters sub-series has garnered its own dedicated following since its debut in 1998. Much like its counterpart in the Pokemon series, Square-Enix's monster-collecting RPG is all about capturing Dragon Quest's weirdest critters and training them to be the very best. With the upcoming entry Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World, the sequel is looking to elevate the monster-collectathon and turn-based battle gameplay even further, all channeled into Dragon Quest's stylized, high-fantasy storytelling that's brought to life by the art style of the legendary Akira Toriyama.

At PAX West 2026, we got some hands-on time with Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World, seeing the expanded narrative with multiple protagonists, collecting some of the Dragon Quest franchise's strangest monsters, and adding them to our party. It's so far got the makings of one of the strangest and most expansive entries to date with over 500 monsters to collect -- but above all, it's especially focusing on the heart and plentiful charm that Dragon Quest Monsters is all about.

The Withered World focuses on the further adventures of Bianca and Nera, the returning protagonists from Dragon Quest V, as they embark on a new journey in another realm. After both of their fathers contract a mysterious illness, they find that the only cure is in a new realm known as the Witherwood, which is dealing with its own crisis. After discovering a magical watering tool to help restore sacred trees in the decaying lands, the pair will team with other monster wranglers and gather a massive party of monsters to help bring balance to the realm and save their parents.

What makes the Dragon Quest Monsters sub-series such a well-loved spin-off is that it often goes for a more light-hearted, folksy adventure that's enjoyable for all ages. Moreover, it really leans into the inherent charm and weirdness of the Dragon Quest series by letting you team up with some of the franchise's most bizarre foes. Yes, you can have a party full of the Slime monsters, and that could very well be a powerful team if you power them up well enough.

But what Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World focuses more than other games is the experience of its lead monster wranglers, Bianca and Nera. In contrast to Pokemon, DQ Monsters makes the lead monster wrangler more of a key fixture of the party than previous games, and The Withered World especially does that with both Bianca and Nera having unique perks and favored monster types. This creates more opportunities and benefits for building out specific monster parties for the specific wranglers, especially with Bianca's preference for dragon and beast types.

Though there's more of a narrative following with The Withered World, there's still plenty of time to explore the different zones and build up your party at your leisure. The two areas I got to explore were the starting desert zone around Witherrealm's core kingdom and the tropical island zone with some seriously powerful monsters roaming around. Depending on the protagonist you chose in the beginning, you'll have a party that's built for certain conditions – such as Nera's glasscannon-style build of healing all MP post-battle for magic-focused monsters and resurrecting fallen allies, or Bianca's more brawler build favoring keeping the party's HP topped off and having an easier time bedazzling foes. Still, despite your choices, the protagonists and new monster wranglers will meet up over the course of the adventure and blend their parties.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/dqm-tww-broll-synthesis-combat-02-0-01-06-38-1789173232366.png

Much like other DQ Monsters games, battles play out in the familiar turn-based design, with the monster wrangler offering suggestions on targets and specific attacks, using items to heal allies, or even letting the monsters do their own thing with the auto-battle function. It's fairly standard with its approach and execution, but it all makes for a satisfying flow. I especially appreciate the way party composition works. While you can have a party of four mid-sized monsters, bringing in the larger ones will take up more individual slots, making for a smaller party, but a potentially stronger one depending on your chosen wrangler and what their abilities are.

With apparently over 500 collectible monsters to train and evolve, Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World is really emphasizing the vast roster of allies to acquire. Even during my limited hands-on time, I was blown away by how much variety there was in the selection of monsters. Also, the designs are so expressive and colorful, which really leans into the Toriyama influence. The core way to expand your party is, of course, through battling and scouting. Depending on the type of monsters, you'll meet certain conditions to be able to scout them in the middle of a fight. If you are stronger than them, or if you've managed to beat them down enough, you can outright recruit them during battle, which will add them to your roster and end the fight.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/dqm-tww-broll-synthesis-combat-01-0-06-03-58-1789173232365.png

Along with the familiar beats of battling and collecting monsters, The Withered World also adds the ability to synthesize new ones, essentially merging many of the familiar Dragon Quest monsters into new creations. This is on top of the already large number of base monsters, many of which are spiced versions of existing creatures – such as the Coconut Slime, a more tropical cousin of the enduring Slimes. In my case, I combined a Bantamweight rooster monster with a Platypunk to create a Bullfinch monster, a new powered-up beast that helped add some power to my party.

Unfortunately, one notable issue that came up during previews was that some users might be prone to motion sickness while playing. While I personally didn't experience this, some players in my session and others didn't react well to the visual style of world exploration in particular. This visually interesting world map is presented as a stylized, rolling map that can look a little disruptive to some. Fortunately, the game's accessibility options include ways to ease motion sickness by adjusting the camera and visual effects during exploration.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/dqm-tww-broll-synthesis-combat-01-0-06-19-17-1789173232366.png

So far, Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World is shaping up to be another solid and charming entry in the sub-series. The monster-collecting style of RPG is a fairly crowded market these days, but Square Enix's efforts to double down on the charm and wholesomeness of Dragon Quest's world are what make this series so unique and fun to dive into. I had a blast with my limited time with Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World, and I can't wait to see what other oddities and weird creatures to uncover.
While you're here, check out these recent previews of other big upcoming games we've checked out recently!
Alessandro Fillari is a longtime games media professional. Talk video games with him on BlueSky at @afillari.bsky.social .

items.title: 继西贝之后再次锐评！罗永浩又炮轰知名餐饮难吃
items.summary: 快科技9月12日消息，罗永浩发文表示，他在机场试了一下暴得大名的野人先生，觉得味道很一般，考虑到价格，甚至可以说难吃，它是怎么…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122200309870.png
快科技9月12日消息，罗永浩发文表示，他在机场试了一下暴得大名的野人先生，觉得味道很一般，考虑到价格，甚至可以说难吃，它是怎么火起来的？他还表示，感觉野人先生比钟薛高难吃多了。
快科技查询获悉，野人先生是一家意式冰淇淋品牌，前身为2011年崔建维创立的野人牧坊。2015年，该品牌正式推出意式手工冰淇淋，并于北京开设首家购物中心门店。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122200422996.png
2024年4月，野人牧坊更名为“野人先生”。更名时其门店已分布于北京、深圳、青岛、西安、南京和苏州等城市。更名后，品牌开放加盟并快速扩张。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122201176711.png
据窄门餐眼数据显示，2024年新开门店244家，2025年新开门店916家。截至2026年6月，野人先生的门店数量已经突破1400家，覆盖30个省份。
其经营范围包括品牌管理、市场营销策划、企业会员积分管理服务、餐饮管理、技术服务、技术开发、技术咨询、技术交流、技术转让、技术推广、软件销售、软件开发、广告发布以及食品销售等。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122201285407.png
值得一提的是，这并不是罗永浩第一次吐槽知名餐饮品牌。2025年9月，罗永浩曾在微博发文称，西贝几乎全都是预制菜，还卖那么贵，实在是太恶心了，他希望饭店能够注明是否使用了预制菜。

items.title: Starfinder: Afterlight 是一款基于我最喜欢的系统之一的 CRPG，在 Kickstarter 上筹集了近 100 万美元，现在看起来已经开始步入正轨
items.summary: Plus, BG3's Neil Newbon voices an insect priest.

content.v: I've been keeping a close eye on Starfinder: Afterlight for a few reasons—firstly, I'm a Pathfinder 2e sicko, and Starfinder 2e works on a ton of the same rules. Secondly, because I love a good CRPG, and thirdly, because this game has a surprising amount of financial and voice acting heft behind it.

After getting a surprising €828,164 (around $960,000) funded out of a humble €75,000 ask on Kickstarter , the game managed to snag Red Dead Redemption's Arthur Morgan for its narration . It also just so happens to be getting voice direction from Neil Newbon, who you might know as Astarion from Baldur's Gate 3 —and the man's voicing an interstellar priest bug, which is as charming as it sounds.

Alongside some promising key art, I was curious to see if Epicteller Game's debut game could put another solid CRPG on the market—and after going through the playtest, I was rendered… cautiously optimistic . What I played was very rough around the edges, missing features, customisation, and so on.

I shan't say its official demo, which is now out on Steam , has quelled my apprehension completely. It has, however, left me feeling like Epictellers can pull this thing together with enough polish, given the marked improvement from the playtest I enjoyed in March.

First up, the bad: It still runs terribly, and doesn't have any graphical settings at all yet, animations for combat are a touch clunky, and you can't make a custom character—which is a huge draw of any CRPG, though you can pick from three custom premades.

It's also a fairly linear demo, and while I'd be a fool to expect the breadth of something like Baldur's Gate 3, it'd still be nice to have a little more space to roam, meaningful NPCs to talk to, and a side quest or two. As it stands, the demo's just a series of hallways connected by story, with a few choices to make.

But in comparison to what I played in March? It's clear that the polishing is being done. The demo opens with a gorgeously-animated intro that sets the space-swashbuckling tone well, as your ship is assailed by the dreaded Corpse Fleet. Your captain, Khali, heroically tackles their leader off a ledge and leaves you to defend a set of escape pods carrying your crewmates.

You crash-land on the backwater of Akiton, and mysteriously, five years have passed—not a terrible setup for an RPG by any means, and much improved by the fact you immediately meet Newbon's effusive and peppy bug priest with a baby strapped to his chest. Don't worry, it's traditional for Shirren, the little guy's fine.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/aQAcE2KTJVbMFcDYneFtrS.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HhCVYUfwALouRSdA7qqCyS.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xZuV4rTBvpgp557LYELieS.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PTC3jGHwWSGxBNnTAVrazS.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dTfR2LKNCMtmGsvyir3HzS.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8SH6tGERu9wY2uHp2xwxyS.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/vkWPSUARKeMiPTC4aHioyS.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MaUAZMhYFKKn4shAWArrqS.jpg

And while this game chugs, performance issues can be fixed—the more important part is its aesthetic, which is impressive for a studio of this size. Character portraits are lovingly rendered, the comic-book style cutscenes are cute, and Akiton is bright and colourful, plus will look measurably more so when Epictellers figures out how to get it running at a reasonable framerate.

The voice-acting, for a smaller-scale project, is also charming, if a touch inconsistent, but there's a great marriage of voice talent and spectacular character design for your companions, so the focus is in the right place.

The UI is much-improved, carving up character features and abilities into neat little icons, while also tucking plenty of info for min-maxers like me into nested tooltips. And while the combat in the demo is tethered to low-level play, which isn't exciting in any TTRPG system, I can vouch that it will get more interesting as time goes on. As a Pathfinder 2e freak , the three action system has made an evangelist out of me.

It'll need a better tutorial to pull in the layman, mind. I was merrily applying +1 status bonuses and avoiding the dreaded multiple attack penalty because I'm already deeply familiar with the system. As it stands, though, the game awkwardly hucks a bunch of missable tooltips at you in the right corner of the screen. I don't usually advocate for pop-ups, but given how crunchy Starfinder 2e can be, it wouldn't hurt to hold your hand. Or, at the very least, let you know that spamming attacks won't help you.

It's hard to properly tell the trajectory of any given, early project like this—game development is a monstrously complicated business and I'm working with two data points—but I wouldn't bet against Epictellers being able to get this thing ship-shape in time.

items.title: Bulkhead宣布《战狗》发售24小时销量超125万
items.summary: Bulkhead宣布，多人FPS《战狗》发售24小时销量超过125万套。游戏开放抢先体验后迅速吸引大量玩家，但服务器拥堵也给上线初期带来问题。此前《战狗》已在测试阶段展现出较高热度。今年8月举行的测试周末共有约50万名玩

content.v: Bulkhead宣布，多人FPS《战狗》发售24小时销量超过125万套。游戏开放抢先体验后迅速吸引大量玩家，但服务器拥堵也给上线初期带来问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260912/1789220674_579320_jpg_r.jpg
此前《战狗》已在测试阶段展现出较高热度。今年8月举行的测试周末共有约50万名玩家参加，为随后开放抢先体验积累了关注。正式上线时，大量玩家同时涌入，一度导致游戏服务器崩溃。
Bulkhead在公布销量时向玩家表达感谢，并表示工作室正在关注游戏的各项情况、监控服务器，同时观察玩家的实际游玩过程。服务器故障发生后，《战狗》收到了集中出现的负面评价，服务器运行也成为团队当前需要处理的问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260912/1789221025_251523_jpg_r.jpg
游戏采用最多100人参与的大规模战场，并允许玩家自行选择作战方式。其合作机制与现金系统结合，玩家可以向其他人提供报酬，请求直升机运送等支援，也能在倒地后付费请医疗兵实施救援。
目前，《战狗》已经凭借24小时售出125万份取得强劲开局。Bulkhead尚未公布更新后的累计销量，工作室现阶段仍在持续监控服务器运行情况。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 蝙蝠侠出演岛哥哥新作?传《Physint》主演敲定
items.summary: 近日，粉丝们找到了新的实锤线索，越来越确信罗伯特・帕丁森（《新蝙蝠侠》男主）将出演这款谍报动作游戏的主角。而这一切的源头，…

content.v: 近日，粉丝们找到了新的实锤线索，越来越确信罗伯特・帕丁森（《新蝙蝠侠》男主）将出演这款谍报动作游戏的主角。而这一切的源头，是小岛秀夫自己在播客中透露的一段戛纳密会往事。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090942459421.png
据IGN报道，粉丝们重新翻出了小岛秀夫2025年的一期KOJI10播客节目。在那期节目中，小岛秀夫亲口提到，他在戛纳电影节的一场afterparty上与罗伯特・帕丁森见了面，并意味深长地说道：“有一部电影……”虽然他没有明说具体内容，但这句半遮半掩的话，结合《Physint》的选角传闻，立刻让粉丝们炸开了锅，大家普遍认为，这是小岛在暗示与帕丁森的合作已经在推进中。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090946106659.png
这已经不是两人第一次被拍到会面。据多家媒体报道，小岛秀夫和帕丁森此前已经有过多次私下接触，而小岛本人也毫不掩饰对帕丁森演技的欣赏。对于一向喜欢与好莱坞明星深度合作的小岛秀夫来说，多次密会同一个演员，显然不只是粉丝见偶像那么简单。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090949103525.png
早在《Physint》首张概念海报公布时，帕丁森出演的猜测就已经开始流传。海报中那个神秘的角色剪影，无论是面部轮廓还是气质，都与帕丁森高度相似，当时就有大量玩家在评论区惊呼 "这就是蝙蝠侠本人吧"。只不过当时只有一张海报，证据还不够充分。而如今，播客中戛纳会面的爆料相当于又添了一把火，让帕丁森主演《Physint》的说法从猜测变成了高度可信。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/09/small_202609090949192629.png
目前关于《Physint》的公开信息还非常少，除了知道是谍战题材、PS独占之外，发售日和具体玩法都还是谜。反派角色方面，此前有爆料称小岛正在寻找一位有“汉尼拔”气质、带德国口音的演员出演大反派。而主角方面，帕丁森无疑是目前呼声最高、线索最多的人选。当然，这一切目前都还停留在粉丝猜测阶段，小岛秀夫和小岛工作室尚未做出任何官方确认。

content.v: 小岛工作室正在开发的动作谍报游戏《PHYSINT》可能无法继续使用Decima引擎。资深游戏记者及业内人士Paul Tassi称，索尼放弃该项目的决定也包括限制其使用Decima引擎。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260912/1789219779_183833_jpg_r.jpg
按照这一说法，《PHYSINT》后续需要转用其他技术方案，虚幻引擎5是可能的选择之一。小岛工作室也可能开发新的自有引擎及配套工具，但目前尚未确认最终方案。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260912/1789219780_866359.webp
小岛工作室与《地平线》系列开发商Guerrilla Games曾于2016年-2017年间围绕Decima引擎展开合作。此后，小岛工作室在制作《死亡搁浅》系列的过程中持续修改和完善该引擎，并向Guerrilla Games提供工程反馈与技术改进。
如果更换引擎，《PHYSINT》此前针对Decima进行的优化将无法直接沿用。项目可能需要重新搭建部分开发流程，其现有进度和时间安排也可能受到影响；彻底重启开发及延期数年的可能性仍属于推测。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260912/1789219783_642877.jpg
该项目原计划借助索尼影业和哥伦比亚影业的资源融合电影与游戏表现。现有消息称，PlayStation因预算和期限方面的考虑放弃了项目，但相关合作变化以及项目今后的推进方式仍不明确。
截至目前，小岛工作室尚未公布《PHYSINT》的新开发引擎。游戏是否会采用虚幻引擎5、启用自研方案，以及引擎调整是否导致开发计划变化，均有待官方确认。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: PS5独占游戏《漫威金刚狼》中的“放屁气体”引发大量玩家批评，一些玩家呼吁失眠组在游戏中添加完全禁用罗根气味追踪的功能。
《漫威金刚狼》会在特定情况下显示一条气味踪迹，供罗根追踪。这一设定早在今年夏天就已公布并讨论过。本周，随着《漫威金刚狼》评测解禁，围绕这一设定的争论再次升温。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260912/1789219185_230021.jpg
《华盛顿邮报》记者Gene Park将角色身后显示的气味轨迹形容为“屁气”，并测试了游戏中的多项辅助设置。他发现，关闭导航辅助和黄色任务标记后，气味轨迹仍然存在。
“琴·格蕾的屁气痕迹并不是导航辅助选项的一部分。我打开了它，还有另一条绿色线条告诉你该去哪里。任务航点（黄色标记）也是开启的，而且那个可以关闭。第二张图我关闭了选项，屁气还留着。看来屁气是核心功能。”
失眠组公布的辅助功能包含“追逐辅助”，玩家可以借此降低追逐目标的移动速度，但该选项不会关闭气味轨迹，其他导航开关同样无法消除这一效果。因此部分玩家误以为轨迹会全程开启，并要求加入单独的关闭选项。但失眠组社区和市场总监James Stevenson在社交媒体上驳斥了这一说法。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260912/1789219428_431311_jpg_r.jpg
他澄清说：“气味追踪并非一直开启，它代表了洛根作为变种人的超强感官和卓越的追踪能力。只有当他追踪特定的气味/声音（人、威士忌或其他线索气味）时——比如在剧情/任务时刻，或者当他闻到某个收藏品的气味时——它才会出现。”
尽管如此，仍有人希望彻底移除“屁气”这个设定。批评的焦点在于，气味线索对玩家的控制力过强。有人援引之前关于《最终幻想》系列黄色油漆引导线的讨论，指出这些引导线消除了追逐战或探索等环节所需的任何技巧。
有玩家建议，洛根的嗅觉能力或许可以通过按下DualSense手柄上的R3键来触发，这样玩家如果真的不想使用这项能力，就可以选择不用。但根据Stevenson的帖子来看，失眠组认为这种设定对洛根来说并不合理。
对于隐藏收藏品，Stevenson随后补充称，玩家必须先接近到一定范围，洛根才能捕捉相关声音或气味。因此，气味轨迹不会直接从远处标出收藏品，玩家仍需自行探索并进入感知范围。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 三年前，CD Projekt 就想在《巫师》中加入链式武器，但直到《过去之歌》才这么做，因为“当时不可能做到”
items.summary: "A few things had to click together."

content.v: The Witcher 3 's recently revealed expansion Songs of the Past will bring more to CD Projekt's acclaimed fantasy adventure than a new region to explore and quests to pursue, it will also introduce a new weapon for Geralt of Rivia to wield—a gnarly silver chain. Well, "new" might not be a wholly appropriate term for it. Geralt's chain weapon—which appears in the novels—was originally seen in the opening cinematic for 2007's The Witcher, making it one of the earliest things players see in the trilogy. But it hasn't appeared as a tool players can use until now.

Apparently though, CD Projekt has previously considered introducing the chain, having discussed it more than a decade ago during The Witcher 3's original development: "We were talking about implementing the chain even during the original Witcher 3." Jakob Rokosz, Songs of the Past's Game Director, told BBC News (via GamesRadar+ ). "But it was impossible to do at the time for various technological reasons and challenges,

Rokosz didn't go into detail about what those challenges were. But reading between the lines, it sounds like they had to do with the chain's animations or physics engine. "A few things had to click together, because we were actually able to address those challenges and issues," Rokosz explained, noting that they did this during the remastering process for The Witcher 3. "Then we were able to implement a weapon that just feels natural and very fluid and basically realises the fantasy you either read in the books or have seen in the trailer."

But the chain isn't appearing solely because CD Projekt can do it. Senior quest designer Despoina Anetaki, who was also being interviewed by the BBC, explained that the weapon "fits with the narrative theming" of Songs of the Past. "It fits with the new enemies that work with the chain," she continued. "We were able to do crowd control with the swarmions that swarm you and you have to keep them away from you."

Swarmions, I should point out, are a somewhat unimaginatively named new enemy-type coming to Songs of the Past. It also sounds like the chain will act as an alternative to (or outright replacement for) the crossbow introduced in The Witcher 3. Anetaki describes it as "a very cool weapon for players who might be sick of the crossbow by now," suggesting it's designed to play a similar role.

If you want to know more about Geralt's silver chain, our own Joshua Wolens saw the weapon in action at Gamescom last month. Like the crossbow, the chain slows down time when you use it and lets you target specific body parts. Joshua had plenty else to say about Songs of the Past too, like how it focuses on Geralt's friendship with Dandelion, and how much livelier its new region feels than those of the base game and its expansions.

items.title: God Save Birmingham New Preview: This Medieval Zombie Apocalypse Is Steadily Finding Its Vision
items.summary: The developers at Ocean Drive Studios, Inc. have a great concept here, there’s no question. While I found the

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/gsb-cbt2026-combat-scythe-1789172472217.jpg
Key Preview Takeaways:

Zombie apocalypses have certainly been a popular setting for many a game, and it's one that most players know very well. But the open-world survival horror game God Save Birmingham approaches it a bit differently with its main hook. Instead of a modern-era zombie apocalypse filled with tall buildings, firearms, and other modern conveniences, it asks a different question: what would happen if a zombie outbreak occurred in the Middle Ages?

With God Save Birmingham, players have to figure out how to survive swarms of zombies invading the English countryside, first utilizing common farm tools and basic goods, and then steadily building up to crafting proper knightly gear and real fortifications. Developer Ocean Drive Studios, Inc. has been steadily fine-tuning the concept since the game's public debut in 2024, with more players getting access in early playtests to refine it further. We recently got some hands-on time with an updated build at PAX West 2026, and God Save Birmingham's concept of a medieval zombie survival game – and the stronger narrative foundations – is starting to bear fruit.

In early hands-on and playthroughs around its debut, God Save Birmingham featured a fairly bare-bones narrative, mostly relying on its medieval zombie apocalypse hook to do the heavy lifting. The recent build I played offered proper onboarding for its concept, focusing on the protagonist waking up in the town's infirmary and church well after the outbreak has kicked off. In a similar vein to The Walking Dead or 28 Days Later, you play as a lone survivor in this medieval zombie apocalypse, and the first goal is to quickly leave the one safe room in a building filled with zombies and find whatever supplies you can along the way during the escape.

Escaping the infirmary was a decent tutorial of Birmingham's physics-based actions and movement, but it also set the mood effectively. Along with getting the basic feel of its physics and movement system, which really gives a sense of weight and heft to all actions, I had to carefully secure as many supplies as I could – and even some basic clothing. As the lone survivor, all of the townsfolk have turned, leaving the infirmary and the surrounding village to be a zombie-infested nightmare. Getting outside, while totally necessary, also opened up a whole host of problems I had to deal with.

It's an effective opening. Even though it is still very much a zombie apocalypse experience, the medieval setting, along with the scattered journals from priests and townsfolk speaking of the outbreak as a religious reckoning of Hell breaking out on earth, makes this particular take feel more grounded and unnerving than most other survival games. I really appreciated that there's not only better narrative backing to draw you in, but also that Birmingham's revamped journal gives basic direction on what to do next. My preview build also does a much better job of getting players into the flow and concepts across, which makes the lead-up to the familiar, mostly hands-off approach of letting players make their own way through the world feel more natural.

To that end, God Save Birmingham really leans into the survival aspect of its core gameplay. It clearly emphasizes that you'll need to craft bandages to mend wounds, avoid exhaustion and anxiety, consume food and water, and, of course, get some sleep when you can. All of this, of course, while scrounging for precious supplies and avoiding the zombies nipping at your heels. Project Zomboid's influence shows in God Save Birmingham's visually detailed world, which prioritizes realism above all.

Another big improvement in God Save Birmingham is its core combat and physics systems, which let you grab objects and move and adjust them freely. While there's a ton of amusement to be had with grabbing crates and ladders and smacking them against approaching zombies, there's also careful management needed for maintaining your stamina. Stamina management is critical in God Save Birmingham, as a winded protagonist leaves him vulnerable. When carefully managed, you can carry ladders and place them in spots to reach higher vantage points, block doorways, and yes, use your energy to smack ladders against zombies.

The combat is also much improved in the current build of God Save Birmingham, which feels a bit more natural and easier to engage with – as opposed to earlier builds that felt like they were deliberately making the combat clunky to stay in step with the realism they're going for. All weapons have unique animations that define their attack style, power, and range. For instance, a pitchfork is all about keeping distance from enemies, and it's more precision-based with its strikes. Hatchets are close-range weapons, and they have a wider arc to make it easier to land strikes. In keeping with the growth found in survival games, the more you use a particular weapon, the better the protagonist will be at using it.

Given my limited demo time, I spent most of my session collecting resources – particularly finding food, as the lone survivor was mostly famished throughout my playthrough. Once I gathered spring water and tons of apples to consume, I made my way into a tucked storage area in a back alley of a village square. After using my pitchfork to dispatch three zombies that followed along, I lifted three crates to block an opening and hid in the corner. The sun was going down, and I huddled near a fire lit in the corner of the room, still holding my pitchfork. I heard more zombies outside the home; they likely heard me moving in the building or were trailing behind me on the way over. Just as I was preparing to eat leftover chicken on a nearby counter, the demo ended.

That's what I ended up liking most about God Save Birmingham: it really captured the tone of a compelling survival horror game, where every escape has a story behind it. It's still in its early stages, certainly, and the developers are steadily getting a firmer handle on their vision for a medieval-era zombie apocalypse. Recently, the team announced that co-op play will be available in the full game, which unfortunately wasn't playable in the PAX West demo. Still, it's a great addition to come, and having a buddy along with your adventures can really make this survival horror experience feel a bit less isolating.

The developers at Ocean Drive Studios, Inc. have a great concept here, there’s no question. While I found the early builds somewhat uninteresting in execution, the latest build offers a better tone and a reason to feel more invested in this survival story. Hopefully, with more time and more feedback from new players jumping into the early playtests, God Save Birmingham's open-world survival horror experience will steadily become one that's worth keeping an eye on.
While you're here, check out these recent previews of other big upcoming games we've checked out recently!
Alessandro Fillari is a longtime games media professional. Talk video games with him on BlueSky at @afillari.bsky.social .

items.title: 小岛秀夫想扫描真鬼！《OD》直接玩真的了？
items.summary: 小岛秀夫称想扫描真实鬼魂用于恐怖新作《OD》，并称曾与微软同去神社祈福。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122059413804.png
近日，游戏内容创作者NikTek在社交平台X上回顾了一则旧闻：小岛秀夫在去年小岛制作成立十周年的“Beyond the Strand”直播中谈到恐怖新作《OD》时表示，团队不仅在扫描真实存在的“闹鬼地点”，他本人更想成为“世界上第一个扫描到真实鬼魂的人”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122103413771.jpg
据直播现场翻译，小岛秀夫的原话是：“为了《OD》，我想去世界各地那些可怕的地方，第一次扫描一只鬼魂，我还想为此拿个奖。”他同时提到，团队为预告片扫描的房间“本该有鬼”，而预告里那段咔嚓声其实是他们在自家录音室录下的——工作室偶尔会传来奇怪的吱嘎响，他半开玩笑地说“也许曾有鬼，但现在不在了”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122104181050.jpg
为免游戏“被附身”，小岛秀夫还透露自己曾与微软员工一同前往神社，只为“确保游戏版本是安全的”。这位以《合金装备》《死亡搁浅》闻名的制作人向来善于用出格发言制造话题，至于扫描鬼魂究竟有几分认真，外界普遍持保留态度。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122105312235.png
《OD》是小岛制作与导演乔丹·皮尔合作、由Xbox发行的恐怖游戏，于2023年TGA上首次公布。NikTek也顺势调侃，不知道小岛会不会顺手把“鬼的脚”也扫描进去。

items.title: 《GTA6》收藏版包装疑似泄露!神秘黑盒 内藏光盘位置
items.summary: 《GTA6》收藏版包装疑似泄露!神秘黑盒 内藏光盘位置

content.v: 近日，一组疑似《GTA6》收藏版包装箱的照片在海外社交平台流传，引发玩家关注。爆料者自称曾在墨西哥的Unique Services Group参与包装生产，并在X平台晒出了疑似《GTA6》收藏版的包装照片。不过，目前相关消息尚未得到Rockstar官方确认。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101616141324.jpg
爆料者称，自己曾在包装部门工作约一个月，并上传了一张带有“Vice City Leonida”以及《GTA6》“VI”标志的黑色箱体照片，另一张照片则显示仓库内堆放着大量同款包装箱。他还晒出了所谓的工作证件作为身份佐证。该账号随后删除了相关帖子，因此事件真实性进一步成为玩家讨论焦点。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101614193645.png
最值得注意的是包装内部的设计。爆料者表示，这个盒子内部拥有多个区域，整体尺寸甚至比PS5游戏盒更大。他还提到，自己记得内部存在一个圆形结构，因此猜测收藏版可能会配备实体光盘。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101614253517.png
不过，他随后也承认，这只是个人推测，因为自己并不清楚包装最终对应哪个平台，也存在里面根本没有光盘的可能。此前Rockstar已经确认，《GTA6》实体版本将采用盒装游戏代码形式，因此所谓“收藏版实体盘”目前更需要谨慎看待。
爆料者还透露，目前这些包装似乎正在向全球销售地区进行配送，而相关生产预计将在11月结束。不过他不知道收藏版具体何时正式发售，并表示不排除游戏上线后才推出的可能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101616216604.jpg

items.title: Zeverland 游戏设计师讨论其对僵尸启示录的独特看法

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/11/key-art-1789158297255.png
生存制作游戏 Zeverland 为这一类型注入了独特的元素，它的僵尸启示录看起来非常可爱，并且允许你修改你能找到的几乎所有东西。
这意味着你可以用管道胶带将熨斗粘到网球拍上，将其变成致命武器，或者将相机焊接到棒球棒上，让你的攻击充满活力。您还可以通过焊接其他东西并将其变成移动底座来定制您想要的车辆。安装一张床给自己一个休息的地方，或者在你的车辆前部放置撞击钉来消灭成群的僵尸。
在 6 月份最近一次游戏测试之后，Zeverland 根据玩家反馈进行了重大设计更改。最初宣布是一款开放世界的大型多人在线游戏，你可以在其中破坏其他玩家，现在已转向专注于 PvE 合作模式，你可以与朋友一起建造、探索和生存，但也可以进行单人游戏。
在 gamescom 上，我们有机会与 Zeverland 的首席游戏设计师 Cecilia Pan 讨论了其对玩家互相帮助的关注、玩家的创造力、它提供的不同游戏系统等等。
欢迎，塞西莉亚。我们知道《Zeverland》是一款合作生存游戏，你可以粉碎、隐藏和制作一切。但您能告诉我们更多相关信息吗？

Cecilia Pan: The game takes place a few months after a zombie apocalypse. The cities are still there, and you can enter all kinds of buildings, like police stations, hospitals, and convenience stores. You can interact with the objects inside in ways that feel natural, whether that means picking them up, putting them in your backpack, or combining them into weapons. We've already held two playtests, and we're currently planning to launch into Steam Early Access as early as Q1 next year.

Now one thing that stands out to me about Zeverland in general is this emphasis on assisting others versus, you know, fighting enemies. It seems like you're much more incentivizing people to work together. Can you talk to me about that?

Cecilia: Well, it's like this: When a natural disaster strikes, humanity ultimately always chooses to stand together and fight against it. We've played a lot of survival games ourselves, so we really wanted to make a game where, after disaster strikes, people use their own knowledge and creativity to solve survival problems, and eventually work together to take the world back from the zombies.
在大多数情况下，合作游戏是围绕固定的故事情节或开发人员设置的特定老板设计的，玩家必须组队才能征服这些老板。我们想要的是沙盒式的合作形式。游戏的玩法有无数种，玩家可以选择是否要互相帮助。例如，车辆需要燃料。如果你在路上开车遇到另一个幸存者，你可以选择停下来给他们一罐汽油，这样他们就可以继续前进。当然，你也可以选择不。我们希望合作来自于玩家自己的选择。
我们不希望玩家解决了基本的生存问题后就停止合作。我们想看看他们是否可以共同努力做更大的事情。也许他们在河上建造一座桥梁，在高层建筑之间设置滑索，或者找到一种方法来恢复大城市的电力。这些体验需要更多玩家聚集在一起并作为一个团队进行尝试。
这真的很酷。我喜欢这样的想法：你创建了一堆不同的系统，根据玩家与他们的互动方式，你可以激发创造力。现在，您之前谈到过进行两次公开的 alpha 游戏测试，我只是很好奇：在这些 alpha 游戏测试期间是否有任何有趣的故事或您最喜欢的故事？

Cecilia: During Playtest 2, I had a pretty interesting experience myself. I was driving down the road when I came across another player whose vehicle had broken down. I stopped and asked if they needed help. They told me they hadn't brought enough fuel, so their vehicle couldn't go any farther. I gave them some of the fuel I had saved, and we ended up becoming friends.

My second story goes like this: I once ran into a player who had built his entire home, including a personal bar, right on top of his vehicle. As the sun was setting, he parked on the side of the road and opened up a little mobile roadside bar. He and his NPC companion were playing music together, looking absolutely joyful, and I ended up joining them halfway through.

Lots of devs in our team really love this post-apocalyptic theme. While we were designing the game, teammates would often ask me things like, “Can I bring my screaming chicken?” or “Can I bring my little rubber duck?” In most cases, devs will tell players: “You need to complete a great mission.” But we want our world to be filled with small, familiar things from everyday life. Those little objects and little moments can remind players how valuable ordinary life is, and hopefully make them naturally want to come together and solve these survival problems.

Now, you talk a lot about how you kind of iterate on these different design decisions and things like that. You say Zeverland is a game with no limits. What are the kind of gameplay mechanics that you think best express that player creativity and freedom?

Cecilia：我们目前游戏中有超过 6000 个交互对象。我们使用基于 ECS 的交互系统来确保每个对象以感觉自然的方式做出响应。每个物体都有自己的材料属性。木材可以燃烧，而金属可以导电，当下雨时，电力可能会传播得更远。物体的大小和重量也决定了它是否可以放入您的背包中。如果不能，也许你可以把它捡起来然后扔掉，这会造成伤害。一旦玩家了解了这些系统，他们就可以运用常识和自己的创造力来解决生存问题并克服游戏中的挑战。
是的，我的意思是，让我们直接开始武器定制吧。您提到了许多不同的系统，无论是它们如何与元素交互，还是它们如何与环境交互。有多少种不同的武器定制选项？您已经在观察玩家的行为，那么玩家制造的最奇怪的武器是什么？
Cecilia：例如，你可以在武器上安装一个小橡皮鸭，当你击中僵尸时，它会发出奇怪的声音。如果你把僵尸的头打下来，你也可以把那个头附加到武器上，这可能会给武器带来眩晕效果。您还可以在房屋中找到日常用品，例如熨斗，并将其附加到武器上。例如，熨斗可能会让你点燃僵尸。所以有很多这样有趣的组合。
Do those kinds of customization options and player creativity also extend to the vehicles? Are there ways of customizing vehicles, and how do you kind of check out exploration in that regard?

items.title: 《鬼武者》首次通关解锁抽象皮肤 官方:不信你不穿
items.summary: 《鬼武者：剑之道》首次通关后，玩家将解锁一套特殊装束“熊猫玩偶服装”。

content.v: 《鬼武者：剑之道》首次通关后，玩家将解锁一套特殊装束“熊猫玩偶服装”。与游戏本身较为严肃的武士风格不同，这套装束采用了完全不同的视觉设计，让主角宫本武藏穿上一件体型明显更大的熊猫玩偶服，整体画风也随之发生变化。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122050266141.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122050186423.png
游戏内对这套装束的介绍为：“可爱的玩偶服。 据说，穿上这套衣服，是每一位鬼武者都无法回避的宿命。 难道……这也是剑之道？”
从实际效果来看，穿上“熊猫玩偶服装”后，宫本武藏本人会被包裹在大型熊猫玩偶服内部，黑白配色的熊猫造型与游戏原本的武士服饰形成明显反差。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122050422641.png
此外，这套装束还加入了特殊的发光效果。当宫本武藏使用“鬼之力”或开启觉醒形态时，原本以黑白色为主的熊猫玩偶服部分区域会亮起RGB灯光，随着角色进入特殊状态呈现出更加醒目的视觉效果。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122050438178.png
“熊猫玩偶服装”需要玩家完成游戏首次通关后才能解锁，属于通关后的额外装束内容。

items.title: 巫师3重制版确认为新DLC推出！需要沉淀新技术
items.summary: CD Projekt Red方面表示，如果没有重制版带来的技术升级，新扩展中的部分内容可能无法实现。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122035148898.png
据GamesRadar报道，《巫师3：狂猎》即将推出的新扩展“旧时曲”与游戏重制版之间存在密切的开发联系。CD Projekt Red方面表示，如果没有重制版带来的技术升级，新扩展中的部分内容可能无法实现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122036037764.png
在接受BBC News采访时，《巫师3》及“旧时曲”总监Jakub Rokosz谈到了两款内容的开发过程。他表示，要让新扩展最终落地，需要“各方面条件恰好到位”。开发团队当时正好重新关注到吟游诗人丹德里恩的过去以及他的故乡，而就在CD Projekt Red与团队讨论开发相关内容时，《巫师3》重制版的工作也已经展开。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122036135923.png
Rokosz透露，“旧时曲”的部分内容与重制版开发工作因此产生了关联。其中最典型的例子便是丹德里恩的故乡莱顿。他表示，如果没有重制版带来的升级，莱顿这一地区的实现将无法完成，两项工作的技术升级最终为新扩展的开发提供了条件。
Rokosz总结称，要让“旧时曲”成为现实，需要多个开发环节相互配合，而重制版的技术升级正是其中的重要组成部分。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609122036368823.png
GamesRadar指出，《巫师3：狂猎》原版于2015年推出，距今已经过去十余年。随着游戏技术不断发展，重制版预计将带来包括战斗系统改进以及画面升级在内的大量变化，部分调整的规模甚至已经接近传统意义上的重制作品。
此次“旧时曲”的开发也因此与重制版形成了较为紧密的联系。根据Rokosz的说法，重制版解决的一些技术问题，为新扩展中莱滕等内容的实现提供了基础。

榜单认为，《忍者龙剑传》虽然拥有强力首领和容易将玩家撞下平台的敌人，难度在同期作品中也相当突出，但其高速动作体验依然具有吸引力。《恶魔城3：德古拉的诅咒》则凭借多名可用角色、不同路线以及武器组合，为重复通关留下了空间。
《塞尔达传说》1986年率先登陆日本FC磁碟机，1987年进入北美NES市场。游戏允许玩家以较为自由的顺序挑战迷宫，并通过隐藏洞穴中的角色提示寻找装备、对抗加侬。《龙战士4》则在前半段分别讲述多名角色的冒险，最终再让他们与主角会合。
榜单还强调了几款作品适合反复游玩的特点。《魂斗罗》流程不长，可供单人或双人体验；《洛克人2》的内容较后续作品更为紧凑；《唐老鸭历险记》的五个主要关卡可以自由选择挑战顺序，并在场景中安排了大量隐藏内容。
NES于1985年10月18日在北美推出，首发阵容包括《超级马里奥兄弟》和《越野机车》等作品，随后数年间游戏数量增至数百款。本次榜单最终将《超级马里奥兄弟3》列为十款作品之首。

items.title: 《GTA6》不蹭现实热点 R星：开发11年 热点早过时了
items.summary: Rockstar North联合负责人罗布·尼尔森在发售前密集接受采访，透露了不少开发内幕。在接受法国媒体《Trois Couleurs》采访时，他被…

content.v: Rockstar North联合负责人罗布·尼尔森在发售前密集接受采访，透露了不少开发内幕。在接受法国媒体《Trois Couleurs》采访时，他被问及一个玩家关心已久的问题：R星在创作《GTA6》剧情时，会不会参考现实生活中的重大热点事件？尼尔森坦言，因为《GTA6》的开发周期实在太长，团队需要刻意避免加入过于热门的时效性剧情，因为等游戏做出来的时候，那些热点早就过时了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101211279310.jpg
尼尔森在采访中明确了《GTA6》的开发时间线：“这款游戏从2015年就开始开发了，所以这个想法酝酿了很久。团队的大部分成员是在2018年《荒野大镖客2》发售之后才真正开始投入到这个项目中的。”
《GTA6》的概念阶段早在2015年就已启动，但由于R星当时的主力资源都在《荒野大镖客2》上，《GTA6》只能维持小规模的前期团队。直到2018年《大镖客2》发售后，大量人力才转移到《GTA6》上，2020年进入全面制作阶段。从2015年概念启动到2026年11月发售，整个开发周期长达11年。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101211428065.jpg
尼尔森解释道：“我们的开发周期很长，所以必须非常谨慎地选择要放进游戏里的想法。因为等到我们完成剧本创作、选角、拍摄和最终实现的时候，无论是什么，可能已经改变了，也可能已经过时了。”
如果在开发初期加入了当时最火的社会热点、网络mem或时事梗，等几年后游戏终于发售时，玩家可能根本不知道你在说什么。比如2015年最火的梗是“冰桶挑战”，2018年是“skr”，2020年是“打工人”，这些当时刷屏的热梗都有强烈的时效性，放到2026年看只会让人一脸懵。R星显然不想让《GTA6》的剧情因为追逐短期热点而过期。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/10/small_202609101211487816.jpg
尼尔森表示：“所以我们一直在思考某些东西是否经得起时间的考验。我们会审视这些因素，并且只选择那些能够与我们想要讲述的故事以及我们想要构建的世界观相契合的东西。”
尼尔森的话代表着R星不愿意为了赶进度而牺牲品质，也不愿意为了蹭热点而让剧情变得廉价。

content.v: 《海贼王》路飞声优田中真弓近日谈到自己的配音生涯，表示会争取再努力十年左右。这番话随即引起粉丝关注，不少人担心她能否一直为路飞配音至动画完结。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260912/1789216236_594559.jpg
田中真弓是在第20届声优奖颁奖典礼上作出上述表态。她凭借《胆大党》中高速婆婆一角获得最佳配角声优奖，并在获奖感言中提到野泽雅子：“我想自己应该活不到Mako女士那么久，不过我会争取再努力十年左右。”
相关发言在社交平台传播后，多名《海贼王》粉丝表达了不舍。有粉丝希望她不要说这样的话，也有人表示愿意把自己的寿命分给她，只为能够更久地听到路飞熟悉的声音。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260912/1789216237_896943.jpg
目前没有消息显示田中真弓存在健康问题。粉丝的不安主要来自她逐渐增长的年龄，以及《海贼王》动画近期转向季播形式后带来的制作节奏变化。部分观众因此希望，动画最终能够由大多数原班声优共同完成。
田中真弓长期担任蒙奇·D·路飞的声优。她在感言中提到的野泽雅子出生于1936年，自1986年首部《龙珠》动画开播以来一直为孙悟空配音，目前仍活跃在配音工作中。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 世嘉格斗游戏《 VR 战士5 R.E.V.O. 世界舞台》现已加入Xbox Game Pass游戏库。符合条件的PC、Xbox Series X|S用户可通过订阅游玩。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260912/1789215781_767483_png_r.webp
本次入库覆盖Xbox Game Pass Premium、Xbox Game Pass Ultimate和PC Game Pass，不包括基础档位Xbox Game Pass Essential。游戏目前已成为该订阅服务的最新新增作品之一。
《VR战士5 R.E.V.O. 世界舞台》以世嘉AM2于2005年推出的《VR战士5》为基础，经过多次更新和现代化调整。该版本已于2025年登陆Windows PC及Xbox Series平台。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260912/1789215787_994276_jpg_r.jpg
这款世嘉游戏诞生于2005年，当时世嘉AM2平台推出了街机版《VR战士5》，随后又登陆了PS3平台。《VR战士5》在21年后依然如此受欢迎，以下是它的发展历程：
《VR战士5》于2005年在街机平台首次亮相。
2008年，它迎来了首个重大更新版本《VR战士5 R》
2010年，下一个重大更新版本《VR战士5 Final Showdown》问世
2021年，《Final Showdown》推出了重制版《VR战士5 REVO》，之后更名为《VR战士5 REVO 世界舞台》
2025年，该作登陆微软Windows和Xbox Series X平台，也就是我们今天看到的版本。
《VR战士5 REVO 世界舞台》本质上仍然是《VR战士5》，只不过是经过了大幅更新和现代化改造的版本
游戏以多人对战为主要内容，同时也提供离线内容。其目前在Metacritic上的媒体综合评分为78分，微软商店玩家评分接近五星制下的4星。
《VR战士5 R.E.V.O. 世界舞台》将在Xbox Game Pass中提供多长时间尚未公布，订阅用户的具体游玩权限以各档位当前页面信息为准。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: iPhone18Pro/Max正式开启预售！起售价9999元
items.summary: 今晚8点，iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone 18 Pro Max已正式开启预售，起售价为9999元。

content.v: 今晚8点，iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone 18 Pro Max已正式开启预售，起售价为9999元。
据悉，iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone 18 Pro Max均搭载A20 Pro芯片，并采用相同的影像系统。两者的区别在于，iPhone 18 Pro配备6.3英寸屏幕，iPhone 18 Pro Max则配备6.9英寸屏幕。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609121956555168.png
在续航方面，iPhone 18 Pro的视频播放最长可达34小时，iPhone 18 Pro Max的视频播放最长可达43小时。在电池容量上，Pro Max相对来说更加宽裕。
在影像配置方面，iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone 18 Pro Max均采用三颗4800万像素镜头的组合。两个版本的4800万像素融合式主摄均支持可变光圈，支持f/1.48、f/1.8、f/2.8和f/4.0四档调节，能够带来更出色的进光量和景深效果。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/12/small_202609121957075915.png
另外，凭借更大的机身尺寸，iPhone 18 Pro Max为均热板预留的空间可能会更加宽裕。在长时间打游戏、连续录制4K视频或者运行本地大模型时，iPhone 18 Pro Max的帧率稳定性和机身温度控制可能会更加从容一些。
值得关注的是，iPhone 18 Pro系列的灵动岛面积明显变小。这是因为部分Face ID组件被移至屏下，从而带来了更高的屏占比和更好的视觉观感。

items.title: Physint Could Be Xbox's Biggest Gamble Yet
items.summary: Microsoft's Physint hijack is by no means a guaranteed victory, and could be Xbox's biggest gamble yet.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/11/physint-blog-1789143746190.jpg
This is an IGN opinion piece from Simon Cardy, who is always happy to see creators like Hideo Kojima being allowed to push video games forward with new ideas, wherever their home may be.

Microsoft’s hijacking of Hideo Kojima’s Physint is without a doubt the company’s biggest PR win in a year of disastrous news. But this short-term victory could transform into something more difficult, because Physint could well turn out to be one of Xbox’s riskiest ever gambles.

There are reasons to be confident if you’re Xbox. For one, Kojima’s track record matches up against most prestigious video game creators, at least from a critical perspective. For seconds, it would certainly have come as something of an embarrassing shock to Kojima that PlayStation would deem his project not worthy of completion. And so if you’re Microsoft, the thought of Kojima developing a spiritual successor to his PlayStation-associated Metal Gear Solid series with a newfound chip on his shoulder must certainly have been a tempting proposition when talks first started some months back. It’s a near-unprecedented turn of events, with the only real analogue taking place 30 years ago when Final Fantasy 7 moved home from Nintendo to PlayStation partway through its development, a transition that was as formative for the original PlayStation console’s legacy as Kojima’s own Metal Gear Solid.

But while there’s a victory in tempting the belle of the ball away from their previous date, Xbox’s big swing is far from a surefire hit. Aside from conjuring memories of Snake’s adventures, we have no real way of knowing what Physint actually is yet. All we have is a promise of “Action Espionage” and one piece of artwork showcasing a shadowy, jacketed protagonist. Any confidence in Physint emanates purely from Kojima’s track record. From a public perspective, that record is very strong – even the divisive Metal Gear Solid 4 is considered a masterpiece by some – but Xbox has a better understanding of Kojima’s work than even his biggest fans.

That’s because it has access to OD, his current project. And if Xbox has confidence in Physint, that is likely informed by the fact that OD must be shaping up nicely. Surely if Kojima’s new slice of anthological horror wasn’t tracking to be something special, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma and her leadership team wouldn’t be so keen on investing further in his projects. We still don’t know when we’ll be playing what looks like a spiritual successor to P.T., but one unusual byproduct of this Physint bombshell is my newfound excitement for it.

The quality of Physint itself isn’t the only issue Microsoft has to deal with, though. Investing presumably millions of dollars during a period of mass restructuring is not great for morale. And If you’re one of the thousand people reportedly still yet to lose their job at Microsoft over the next year, then I’m sure there’s a certain amount of justified anger to be felt at seeing money be sent in such a luxurious manner here.

Then there are the parallels between Kojima’s work and the development staff that Xbox has let go this year. Arkane, creators of some of the best stealth-action games since Snake entered retirement, will no doubt be looking on as this deal unfolds with bemusement, confusion, or anger. Earlier this summer, the news came of Microsoft’s intention to relinquish control of the immersive sim studio, alongside the likes of Double Fine, Undead Labs, Compulsion Games, and Undead Labs. Right now, the future of Arkane’s current project – an action stealth game set in the world of Marvel’s Blade – is as yet unknown. You can’t help but feel that some people inside of Arkane’s Lyon headquarters must be filled with a level of frustration over seeing their project pushed to the side by Xbox, only for money to be thrown Kojima Productions’ way to build a whole new stealth game from the ground up.

If the Deathloop developer’s future as an independent studio, or with another publisher’s backing, yields a well-received Blade game, or even a brand new stealth project (my fingers will remain forever crossed for Dishonored 3), and Physint doesn’t reach the lofty expectations that come with a Kojima creation, then the egg may well end up on Xbox’s face.

As of now, the yolk is very much on PlayStation, as it would appear that Sony’s loss is everyone else’s gain. Xbox gets a prestigious name to hang its hat on, and thanks to Microsoft’s funding, Kojima gets to continue working on his passion project. But there’s no guarantee that Physint will be the second coming of Metal Gear Solid. I’m not saying I don’t think Kojima can recreate that same magic — I reviewed and loved Death Stranding 2, which more than slightly borrows from The Phantom Pain’s stealth-action sandbox — but there’s no denying that even if it's critically well received, Physint is not locked in to be a bestseller.

And that’s the bottom line of what Sony has been about across the PS5 generation. Ingenuity and innovation have seemingly been pushed aside in favour of maximising profits. It’s likely no coincidence that Death Stranding 2, a rare PlayStation 5 exclusive that shows creative ambition, will, as of now, be the last Kojima game to hit a Sony console — a fact still hard to believe when you consider just how much 1998’s Metal Gear Solid shaped the original PlayStation and the cinematic aspirations of that console and its successor’s libraries. As of now, we’ve heard very little about how DS2 has done sales-wise, which is likely not a good sign of its commercial performance. With Bloomberg reporting that Physint had already missed deadlines and was looking to come in well over budget , it couldn’t be much clearer that this was an economic decision rather than a creative one. If Physint doesn’t make a healthy profit for Microsoft, will this still look like Xbox getting a win over its old rival?

The console wars as we once knew them felt all but over, but this one game has the power to reignite the competition; a crucial playing piece added to the board that could shape the future perception of each platform holder. We’re years away from knowing who this gamble will pay off for most, though. Kojima, as he tries to prove whether he can reinvent the stealth-action genre once again? Xbox and its faith in one of gaming’s most influential creators at the expense of jettisoning other talent? Or PlayStation, who perhaps saw the writing on the wall well before anyone else, at the expense of appearing creatively short-sighted in the moment? I guess we’ll keep waiting, huh.
